catalyst.name: Opalescent Vigor
catalyst.desc: When Starting an escape, gains 2 Life Stones per tier.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade increase the player's starting life by 30 per tier. This life amount scales with percentage heals (Healing Shards, Adventurer's Gift, specific Auras) as well as Armor's damage reduction. The first 3 points are a relatively cheap way to gain some additional starting life.

catalyst.name: Magic Symbiosis
catalyst.desc: Restores 25% Mana per tier when entering a new room.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade restores a large percentage of mana at the start of every room. 2 Tiers are very cheap and guarantee that the player will start each boss encounter with maximum mana. This upgrade also allows the player to spam spells to buildup their Zodiac Summon meter.

catalyst.name: Evolutive Growth
catalyst.desc: Gains 1% bonus Strength per tier for each Hero's level.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade allows the player's damage to scale up as they progress through the run. Each Tier is worth around two Strength Stones.

catalyst.name: Best Customer
catalyst.desc: Gains 1 Free Drinks per tier for each visit of Andromeda's Bar.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade provides the player with 1 Free Drink at Andromeda's Bar per Tier. You can think of this as 8 Free Stars per world, which adds up very quickly and is even more impactful in high Destiny Levels due to drink cost increases.

catalyst.name: Fallen Plumes
catalyst.desc: Spawns 1 Pavo's Feather, +1 Level per tier, in Intro Room of each world.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade provides the player with 1 Free Feather at the start of every world, 5 per run per tier. The first tier is relatively cheap for player's who like to upgrade their spells often.

catalyst.name: Blessing of the Crystals
catalyst.desc: Increases Quartz gain by 10% per tier.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade increases all Quartz gained by the player. This can greatly increase the ability to reroll or buy high level spells or rare gambits in the shop, especially in later areas. The first couple tiers are impactful for the cost.

catalyst.name: Star Shards
catalyst.desc: Healing Shard's drop changes increase by 25% per tier.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade Increases the number of Healing shards a player encounter's by 25% per tier. Two points in this upgrade will go a long way in ensuring the player has much greater sustain during a run. This increased sustain can allow the player to take greater advantage of a Pavo's Ruins or Moon Room.

catalyst.name: First Strike
catalyst.desc: Increases Damage on full life enemies by 60% per tier.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade Let's the player get a much larger hit on enemies. In particular, this works well against bosses with a well-timed summon or to wipe out any smaller enemies very quickly. This upgrade becomes more important for higher Destiny Levels to ensure that the player can clear a room quickly.

catalyst.name: Vital Points Seeker
catalyst.desc: When starting an escape, gains 2 Critical Hit Stones per tier.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade allows the player to start with 2 Critical Stones per tier. Each tier is worth 4% critical chance, or roughly 2% More damage by default. It is best combined with Sixth Sense for much heavier critical hits.

catalyst.name: Adventurer's Gift
catalyst.desc: Restores 3% Life per tier when entering a new room.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade provides the player with 3% life recovery per room or 36% per world (12 rooms). Three points allows the player to heal their entire life bar over the course of a full world and provides 18% life recovery before each Zodiac Fight. This upgrade allows the player to play a bit more aggressively as small hits will be recovered, especially if the player is also stacking armor.

catalyst.name: Exponential Speed
catalyst.desc: Gains 1% bonus Attack Speed per tier for each Hero's level.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade allows the player to scale their attack speed over the course of a run. It's worth about two Attack Speed stones per tier.

catalyst.name: Fidelity Card
catalyst.desc: Gains 1 free Re-roll in each Shop per tier.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade provides the player with 1 free re-roll at each shop. This lets the player fish for different spells and gambits that align with the player's build, very cheaply.

catalyst.name: Warming Bonds
catalyst.desc: At the start of Zodiac fights, gains 1 Protection absorbing 1 hit.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade allows the player to ignore the first hit they would receive in each Zodiac fight. This is more impactful at higher destiny levels or for Glass Cannon builds.

catalyst.name: Ikki's Force
catalyst.desc: When starting an escape, gains Ikki's Echo, reviving Hero when Life reaches 0.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade provides the player with one free revive in every world. It's the rough equivalent of 10 life stones in value and relatively expensive as far as Catalyst upgrades go.

catalyst.name: Sacred Dew
catalyst.desc: Increases Healing Shards base restoration amount by 10% per tier.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade multiplies the effect of Healing Shards by 10% per tier. At max it will take the 50% heal and turn it into a 75% heal. It can be a useful upgrade for extending your overall health bar.

catalyst.name: Warrior's Pride
catalyst.desc: Gains +1 Strength Stones every 3 enemies killed, stacking up to 2 Strength Stones per tier until Hero gets hit.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade provides the player with additional incentive to avoid hits, to maintain your killstreak. For every tier, your maximum killstreak increases by 6 enemies and 2 Strength Stones. This becomes very difficult to maintain at higher difficulties but can function as a small speed increase.

catalyst.name: Scale Core
catalyst.desc: When starting an escape, gains 1 Armor Stones per tier.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade increases the player's starting armor by 3% per tier. While this may seem small, armor stacks exponentially, meaning that a player starting with 5 stones will see greater returns on future armor. Armor also multiplies any healing a player has, so this can make the player much more robust.

catalyst.name: Zodiac's Emblem
catalyst.desc: Increases the Charge Speed of Zodiac Summons by 20% per tier.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade increases the speed of the Zodiac summon meter by 20% per tier. Two or three tiers will allow the player to Summon their Zodiac multiple times during a Zodiac fight.

catalyst.name: Beyond Infinity
catalyst.desc: Increases Spells Max Level by +1 per tier.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade increases the maximum level of spells. While powerful, a player should prioritize this after they gain more consistency in Pavo Feather's, such as through the Fallen Plumes Catalyst upgrade.

catalyst.name: Star-Forged
catalyst.desc: Gains 1 additional use per tier of the Aura Refiner in Andromeda's bar.
catalyst.strategy:
This upgrade provides the player with an extra use of the Aura Refiner, up to 1 use in every Andromeda's bar. When this is fully upgraded, the player may find that they have more uses than they need, in which case the player may scrap the aura refiner for star fragments, which can immediately be used at Andromeda's bar.

In multiplayer, the player's receive an extra use of the Aura Refiner, meaning that a player should only upgrade this to the 1st tier, as the 2nd tier cannot be used.

catalyst.name: Locksmith
catalyst.desc: Gains 2 Keys per tier in Zodiac Chests (Zodiac Fight Reward Chest).
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade provides the player with 2 keys per tier after every Zodiac Boss Fight. While this may seem small, the impact is significant, especially for the cost of the first three tiers (10 Fragments). Each Tier is worth 8 Keys per run, meaning that the player can instead select a non-key room for any other reward as well ass access to a stone shrine for access to more Pavo Feathers or Stat Stones.

catalyst.name: Spirit Friends
catalyst.desc: When starting an escape, gains +1 random Echo per tier.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade allows the player to start with 1 free random starting Echo per tier. It stacks with Ikki's Force Catalyst mod as well as the Telluric Telescope "The Ghost Army", allowing the player to have a large number of Echoes. Starting with More Echoes has the side effect of making the Echo Isles more valuable, as the pool of Echoes will be reduced.

catalyst.name: Andromeda's Memory
catalyst.desc: Gains 1 Random Stones per tier in The Void Chests. (Void Room Mini-Boss Fight Reward Chest)
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade provides the player with 1 Random stone per tier in the Void Room Mini-Boss chests. This greatly increases the value of these rooms, allowing them to provide experience, a Spell unlocker, a Gambit and up to 3 stats. As these fights show up in nearly every world, this can be worth up to 4 stats per tier.

catalyst.name: Sixth Sense
catalyst.desc: Increases Critical Hit Damage by 10% per tier.
catalyst.strategy: This upgrade provides the player with a significant increase to critical damage, raising the base from 50% more damage to 100% more damage at max tier. While this upgrade is expensive, it provides the player with a way to break through the larger enemy life bars at higher destiny levels.

telluric.name: The Air Pump

bosses.name: Taurus

attacks.name: Astral Tri-Slasher
attacks.text: Taurus summons forth three devastating energy slashes, with the third one splitting and sweeping across both sides of the arena.

attacks.name: Horned Havoc Hurl
attacks.text: Taurus throws his sword toward the player with tremendous force, until it hits the opposing wall. Once it hits the wall, Taurus channels his magic into his fist before charging towards his sword with unstoppable momentum.

attacks.name: Cosmic Slash Barrage
attacks.text: Taurus initiates a series of strikes by raising his sword high, launching himself forward into a sequence of four rapid slashing attacks. It should be noted that the fourth attack has a longer range than the first three.

attacks.name: Bladewarp Strike
attacks.text: Taurus teleports his sword directly on top of the player, then teleports himself into the weapon and delivers a quick and devastating attack.

attacks.name: Ethereal Saber Shower
attacks.text: Taurus teleports to the middle of the arena before raising his sword into the air, summoning Ten ethereal energy swords around it, five on each side. He then hurls each energy sword at the player in succession, with each subsequent sword moving faster than the last. It should be noted that Taurus will only use this attack when at or below 50% health.

attacks.name: Azure Inferno (Ultimate)
attacks.text: When Taurus's Astral Gauge is filled, his arm ignites with intense blue flames. He slams it into the ground, causing the entire arena to be engulfed in astral flames. As the flames spread, Taurus summons one-time hit targets that appear in the air. Players must hit these targets to stay airborne and avoid falling into the fiery inferno below.

bosses.strategy:
Taurus is widely considered the easiest boss in the game, most of his attacks can't hit an air-born target, with the exception of Ethereal Saber Shower, Astral Tri-Slasher, and Bladewarp Strike. Horned Havoc Hurl, and Cosmic Slash Barrage can all be easily dodged by either staying in the air or by dashing through them at the right time.
The only challenging move to dodge is his Ethereal Saber Shower, as the blades get increasingly faster at a rapid pace towards the 4th-5th thrown sword. To dodge this move fully, it's better to rely on dashing, jumping and fall attacks all at once to fully dodge it.
His ultimate is fairly the easiest ultimate to survive in the game, as long as the player doesn't shout down the targets too fast, players should have a small time interval between each target shot, to stay air-born throughout the whole ultimate
* Strategy forAyla: Using Ayla's signature spell whenever Taurus uses a move is a great way to deal dmg while also staying safe, as it grants a small amount of invincibility frames, and it teleports the player behind the boss, it can be used at the end of Astral Tri-Slasher, Honed Hurl Havoc and Bladewarp Strike, it could also be used to dodge the Ethereal Saber Shower attack.
* Strategy forKiran: Kiran especially shines in this boss fight, since all of Taurus's moves are easy to predict and counter, the player should always counter the last hit of Astral Tri-Slasher as well as the last hit of Cosmic Slash Barrage, countering the hits of Ethereal Saber Shower is also a valuable strategy, Bladewarp Strike and Horned Hurl Havoc can be countered but it's better to save the counter for the other two, rather easier and more obvious moves.
* Strategy forOctave: Octave takes great advantage of the fact that Taurus can't counter air camping, since Octave has ranged normal attacks that can hit enemies while air-born, the player can stay above the ground for as long as needed, only coming down to cast spells at the right time, then jumping back into the air.
* Strategy for Calie: Similar to Octave, Calie can stay air-born while hitting Taurus from a safe distance.

bosses.name: Virgo

attacks.name: Blade Discharge
attacks.text: Virgo conjures a ball of lightning above her head that releases a series of electric blades starting at her position and fanning outwards around her. The blades then explode in a small area.

attacks.name: Thunderclap
attacks.text: Virgo dashes so fast that she seems to appear from both sides of the arena and makes two large electric slashes crashing into the center of the arena. She then strikes the middle of the arena causing electric spikes to jump from the floor.

attacks.name: Volley Snap
attacks.text: Virgo snaps her fingers and sends a volley of electrifying energy bullets towards the player. These energy spheres damage the player while they are moving to their destination.

attacks.name: Lightning Blades
attacks.text: Virgo raises her arm and creates an electric energy blade. She then dashes and swings her blade at great velocity at the player and quickly does a smaller slash right after, both aimed in the player's direction.

attacks.name: Surge Dash
attacks.text: Virgo quickly vanishes from the arena and several orbs of lightning appear dictating Virgo’s path. She then dashes in the indicated direction at a high speed, damaging any player in her path.

attacks.name: Speed of Light (Ultimate)
attacks.text: Virgo transforms into lightning itself, glowing yellow and quickly vanishing from the arena. She then dashes at great speeds and makes several patterned danger zones. She progressively dashes faster and faster until she's done attacking.

bosses.strategy:
Virgo is one of the very first bosses a player may encounter yet she could be considered the hardest of the three bosses within the Fragmented Plains. This is due to many of her abilities being very fast. Moves like Surge Dash, Lightning Blade, and Vanishing Crash can catch a player off guard. Alongside this, her tendency to vanish off the screen allows her to reset her advantage. One of her moves to be aware of when playing Ayla or Kiran is her Electric Discharge. Since it shoots directly where she is standing and fans outward, it's a great "get-off-me" tool that she uses when the player is too close.
Virgo's Ultimate, Lightning Speed, is another ability that adds to her difficulty. Players who aren't used to her speed and the attack pattern can get confused. Especially, towards the end of it when it is so fast that the patterns begin to overlap.

attacks.name: Conjure: Missiles
attacks.text: Capricorn uses his books to conjure unique abilities, The book with a "Q" shape, Shoots several missiles at the player.

attacks.name: Conjure: Shield
attacks.text: Capricorn uses his books to conjure unique abilities, The book with a circle provides a barrier to Capricorn that makes him unable to take damage.

attacks.name: Conjure: Ice Spikes
attacks.text: Capricorn uses his books to conjure unique abilities, The book with an upward arrow Summons ice Pillars that slowly rise from the floor from one side of the arena to the other. Damaging the player.

attacks.name: Conjure: Lightning Sphere
attacks.text: Capricorn uses his books to conjure unique abilities, The book with a star summons lighting orbs of varying heights that continuously zap the ground. These orbs will persist until the book is destroyed, and there can be a maximum of up to 4 orbs.

attacks.name: Twin Astral Beams
attacks.text: Capricorn steady his arms and prepares to shoot two lasers, twice. He alternates between two orientations for the lasers. One set is towards the middle of the arena forcing the player to jump over while the other sets the beams above the ground and in the air.

attacks.name: Meteor Shower
attacks.text: Capricorn imbues his arm and raises it into the air, calling down two to three meteors to strike the player at their location.

attacks.name: The Pursuit of Knowledge (Ultimate)
attacks.text: Capricorn becomes one with the cosmos, taking on an astral form, turning as black and covered in an intense blue fire. He then imbues himself with one of his books and goes to the center of the arena, summoning down a shower of meteors.

bosses.strategy:
Capricorn is one of three bosses that the player may encounter first. He is a deadly mage who has astral powers and his conjure books overwhelm his opponents. While his move set is small the main point of Capricorn is to make the player more aware of enemy attacks and the state of the arena.
When fighting Capricorn it is important to know that he can have multiple books up while also attacking the player. To defeat Capricorn efficiently, the player must break his books quickly before it becomes too chaotic. As well as destroying the book, when conjured, the book's symbol will briefly flash, allowing the player to know what Capricorn is doing. It is best to memorize what each symbol does, especially since Capricorn imbues himself with one of his book's powers when he begins his ultimate.

bosses.name: Leo

attacks.name: Crushing Might
attacks.text: Leo prepares his halberd and leaps into the air, smashing it down upon the unfortunate player that doesn't dash out of the way fast enough. He does this twice, always moving towards where the player is.

attacks.name: Protective Maelstrom
attacks.text: Leo rears back and begins spinning rapidly with his halberd, turning himself into a sharpened tornado. He sweeps towards the player at a steady rate, and will follow if the player dashes across him.

attacks.name: Spinning Axe Slash
attacks.text: Leo spins his halberd rapidly, then throws it across the arena. it moves as if it has a mind of it's own, carving out a path denoted by the blue lines and dots. When it finishes, Leo catches it in the air and drops to the ground.

attacks.name: Titanic Toss
attacks.text: Leo stomps the ground and makes two boulders of different heights appear on both sides of the arena. One boulder covers the top, and the other covers the bottom. Once they are in position, Leo kicks them across the arena, damaging any player in its colossal path. While the bottom and top boulder can be on which ever side, they will always be opposite of each other, and Leo will always kick the bottom one first.

attacks.name: Beast: Uncaged
attacks.text: Unlike the other zodiacs, whose Astral Gauge fills up over time, Leo's Astral Gauge fills up in proportion to how much damage he takes. When at 50% health, Leo channels his passion, purpose, and the strength of the first flame into his body, releasing the animal caged within. His entire body becomes imbued with flame, and nearly all of his attacks became far more dangerous.

attacks.name: Crushing Might (Uncaged)
attacks.text: Leo now leaps three times with his halberd, delivering the same crushing blow each time. However, the third leap is slightly faster than the first two.

attacks.name: Protective Maelstrom (Uncaged)
attacks.text: While spinning, Leo now leaves dark embers on the ground that damages players when walking on them, forcing the player to land in between the embers to not take damage.

attacks.name: Spinning Axe Slash (Uncaged)
attacks.text: Leo now throws his halberd across the arena twice, in either an A-shape or a V-shape, depending on which corned he throws it from. If he throws it from either bottom corner, it will do the A-shape first, then the V-shape on the rebound.

bosses.strategy:
Leo can be a very intimidating fight when first encountered. His beast-like nature and large, powerful attacks are sometimes all he needs to fin a fight. However, most of his attacks are not too terrible to dodge once you recognize them.
Like nearly any boss, recognizing his tells re the key to success, then the rest is positioning.

attacks.name: Close Encounter
attacks.text: Sagittarius teleports behind the targeted player, forming an invincible shield and throwing her Chakram at the player. As she throws it, the ring splits into three smaller Chakrams, dealing damage to any players hit. If the player is standing next to a wall, she will instead teleport to the nearest open space to the player.

attacks.name: Sweeping Rage
attacks.text: Sagittarius will Start spinning her chakram at high speeds as it grows spikes out of the blue flames. She will then kick the chakram around the arena, creating large areas of damage that extend to both sides of the battlefield.

attacks.name: Spinning Hatred
attacks.text: If the targeted player is close enough, Sagittarius will swirl her chakram multiple times in a circle around her, forcing the player to move away from her or get hit.

attacks.name: Solar Flare
attacks.text: Sagittarius will disappear from the arena and imbue her chakram with fire, while it hovers to the middle of the arena and starts spinning rapidly. As it spins, it will launch fireballs in patterns around the arena, denoted by the large red zones. These zones reach to the top of the arena, so the only way to dodge this attack is to rush to the safe zones between the fire.

attacks.name: Wheel of Immolation
attacks.text: Sagittarius will begin hovering in the center of the arena, imbue her chakram with fire, and leave it spinning behind her. As it spins, it forms arena-wide chains of fireballs that will rotate either clockwise or counter-clockwise, but will not switch direction mid-attack. There will be gaps in each fireball chain that the player must go through to avoid taking damage, or dash through the chain altogether.

attacks.name: Focused Animosity (Ultimate)
attacks.text: When her Astral Gauge is fully charged, Sagittarius will transform her chakram into it's original form, Nergal's Bow. With the bow in hand, Sagittarius will release a volley of dozens of arrows in 4 waves, 2 from the right and 2 from the left. These small arrows will hit randomly around the arena, denoted by red targets that the player must avoid. After she is done firing all 4 waves, Sagittarius will hover directly above the player, and prepare to launch an extremely powerful arrow that creates a huge column of fire where it lands.

attacks.name: Fire Trail Combo
attacks.text: Aries will use her gauntlets to summon fire trails that erupt when she rhythmically punches. The trails are denoted by the red lines across the screen, which will then erupt at the moment Aries punches, damaging any play still inside.

attacks.name: Raging uppercut
attacks.text: Aries will dash to the player, and attempt to deliver a powerful uppercut. Being one of the fastest moves in her arsenal, it can easily catch a player off-guard.

attacks.name: Ruthless Chain
attacks.text: Aries will rush towards the player, punching in a straight line towards the player of they are on the ground, and exploding in a circle of fire if the player she is targeting is in the air. Just like her Fire Trail Combo this attack is very rhythmic, and needs to be dodged as such.

attacks.name: Grab 'n Smash
attacks.text: Aries will stay still, and begin focusing on a circular attack that tracks the player. The attack follows very closely behind the player, and if the player is inside the circle whenever it strikes, they will be caught by the attack. When Aries catches a player, she keeps them stationary while she dashes towards them, uppercutting them, and then slaming them into the ground from the air. It should be noted that the only part of this attack that does damage is when the player hits the ground.

attacks.name: Volcanic Slam
attacks.text: If the player is close enough, Aries will slam one of her gauntlets into the ground, causing a large area to erupt in flaming stone. This attack is nearly as quick as her Raging uppercut, and requires a quick reflex to dodge.

attacks.name: Targeted Anger
attacks.text: Aries will dash to the side of the arena furthest from the player, and put up an invincible shield around her self while she charges up one of her gauntlets. While she is charging, floating targets will appear one-by-one, moving closer to Aries as you break them. When first activated, this attack reaches the top of the arena, and cannot be dodged. However, each target defeated will lower the range of the attack, allowing the player to jump above the attack once almost all of the targets have been broken. Aries will only use this attack when she is at or below 50% health.

attacks.name: Sincere Apology (Ultimate)
attacks.text: Aries will dash to the center of the arena and begin floating in the air, with an invincible shield around her. As she charges up the attack, blue fireballs will by pulled upward from the ground, damaging the player as they fly towards Aries. Once charged, Aries will punch the ground and create a massive eruption of blue fire in the center of the arena, leaving only the sides to stand on. At the same time, multiple, diagonal, blue fire trails will cover the sides, leaving only a few safe areas to exist in (usually in the air).

attacks.name: Royal Proclamation
attacks.text: Scorpio announces his arrival by riding powerful waves across the arena, summoning lightning strikes as he moves. He makes two passes, both aimed towards the player.

attacks.name: Spearfishing for Insects
attacks.text: Scorpio jumps into the air and throws clones of Cobalt at the player, which explode into a burst of water after a second. The amount of clones Scorpio throws are dependent on how much health he is missing.

attacks.name: Cobalt's Wrath
attacks.text: Scorpio launches three clones of Cobalt into the sky, before disappearing in a swirl of water. the three clones fall down around the player, with the middle one aimed directly at the player, and the other two falling to either side. After they land, Scorpio follows with the true Cobalt, attempting to slam onto the player with a large area of damage.

attacks.name: Forge-master's Technique
attacks.text: Scorpio creates about 10 reality slashes with his hand, either randomly placed or converging on the player. Once he finishes planning the attack, all the slashes activate at once, removing any impurities unfortunate enough to be caught in the attack.

attacks.name: Blacksmith's Puzzles
attacks.text: Scorpio plans a series of cuts with his magic, then quickly follows the path with Cobalt, damaging any player that happens to be in the way.

attacks.name: Bow Beneath Me!
attacks.text: Scorpio has had enough of your insolence and intrusion! He summons a lightning storm, and attempts to slam Cobalt into the player in a large, forceful splash of water. He attempts to crush the player 3 times, calling down 3 randomly placed lightning strikes with each blow. Finally, Scorpio will fall straight down onto the player, Cobalt's prongs aimed to strike. When he lands, two huge lightning beams sweep across the arena on eaither side of him, forcing the player to dash out of the initial strike, then back towards Scorpio to avoid getting hit.

bosses.name: Pisces

attacks.name: Music Chord: Aqua (Guitharp Form)
attacks.text: Pisces strums her guitharp and makes 6 water spheres that rotate around. She then strums her guitharp, sending them towards the player.

attacks.name: Music Chord: Rain (Guitharp Form)
attacks.text: Pisces plays her guitharp causing red notes to fall from the sky. They slowly descend to the ground and explode when near the player or hitting the ground.

attacks.name: Music Chord: Mines (Guitharp Form)
attacks.text: Pisces plays her guitharp summoning orange notes that slowly hover to the player. Once close enough the notes expand and detonate, exploding.

attacks.name: Music Chord: Summon (Guitharp Form)
attacks.text: Pisces plays her guitharp and summons 6 notes that each summon a Piercing Shark.

attacks.name: Form Change: Absolute Zero (Ultimate)
attacks.text: Pisces rises to the center of the arena and transforms her guitharp into a glacial rapier. Changing forms from a musical enchantress to a speedy fighter. Becoming faster and changing her attack pattern.

attacks.name: Glacial Blades (Rapier Form)
attacks.text: Pisces summons 4 ice swords that go into the air , take aim at the player and launch themselves at the player.

attacks.name: Icicle Shuriken (Rapier Form)
attacks.text: Pisces sends three ice shuriken that go in a 0°,35°, and 70° angle that return once they reach the end of their path.

attacks.name: Ice Dance (Rapier Form)
attacks.text: Pisces dances around the arena, leaving ice clones of herself that explode shortly after.

attacks.name: Frost Quake (Rapier Form)
attacks.text: Pisces slams at the center of the arena causing ripples of ice spikes to launch from the floor.

attacks.name: Flowing Current (Rapier Form)
attacks.text: Grapple - Pisces twirls in place before blinking out of the arena and quickly dashing towards the player. Thrusting her sword and smashing the player into the wall.

bosses.strategy:
Pisces is a form-changing boss. Within her first form, she uses her guitharp to attack the player. Having a slow but large area of effect move set. The most difficult part about her music form is her Music Chord: Summon. This is because she still attacks the player, forcing the player to focus on her as well as the enemies summoned.
The difficulty comes once she uses Absolute Zero, changing her guitharp into her blades. This is when she becomes quite a formidable boss. The player should be careful of Flowing Current, Frost Quake, and Ice Dance. All of which are great at area denial and can deal serious damage if not cautious.
For Frost Quake, Pisces often incorporates it within the end of other moves like Ice Dance and Glacial Blades (not limited to those only). Her constant movements of Ice Dance into Frost Quake can confuse the player if they aren't prepared.

attacks.name: Breaching the Surface
attacks.text: Cancer dashes towards the player and attempts to kick them twice, first spraying a wave of water, then creating a wheel of water with a backspin kick.

attacks.name: Avian Artillery
attacks.text: Cancer will concentrate on controlling Basileus, who will hover in a chosen spot in the arena, attempting to blast the player with a sweeping laser. It should be noted that the amount of sweeps Basileus does is based on how much Health Cancer is missing.

attacks.name: Sea of Storms
attacks.text: Cancer teleports to one side of the arena, and kicks a water spout across the arena, then does the same thing on the other side. These water spouts bounce off of each other and the arena walls, but they are low enough to be jumped over and thin enough to be dashed through.

attacks.name: Bird of prey
attacks.text: Basileus lands on Cancer's arm, who then throws Basileus across the arena, damaging any player in the way. When he reaches the end of the arena, Basileus turns around and returns to Cancer, dropping bombs along the way.

attacks.name: Feeding Frenzy
attacks.text: Basileus summons multiple clones of himself across the arena, who then dive around the arena in a random order and direction. Cancer will use this attack when at or below 50% health.

attacks.name: Deep Water
attacks.text: Cancer stands still to concentrate, and summons rushing waves that follow the player. Clones of Basileus will periodically breach out of the water, damaging any player who doesn't move out of the way.

attacks.name: Fit for a King (Ultimate - Mounting)
attacks.text: Once Cancer's Astral Gauge is full, Cancer and Basileus merge into a single unit, with Cancer riding on Basileus' back. They fly above the arena, using new attacks to try to defeat the player. This phase lasts for 15-30 seconds, and it should be noted that Cancer is able to be attacked during this phase.

attacks.name: Avian Charge (Mounted)
attacks.text: cancer dives at the player on the back of Basileus, trying to crush them with his mass and speed. Right before he dives, he releases a pink pulse, which is when the player should dodge out of the way.

attacks.name: Avian Strafe (Mounted)
attacks.text: Cancer and Basileus fly out of view, then will try to fly through the player from one of the main cardinal directions. He will do this up to four times.

attacks.name: Avian Dive (Dismounting)
attacks.text: Cancer and Basileus dive onto the player from above, creating a large area of damage. When Basileus passes the ground, Cancer jumps off to face the player once again, which marks the end of the mounted form. This impact also sends two waves of water jets erupting from the ground in both directions.

attacks.name: Barreling Slam
attacks.text: Aquarius Jumps into the air, then throws he barrel down at the player. When it hits the ground, it fires a blast of water in the direction of the player.

attacks.name: Bubbly Personality
attacks.text: Aquarius slams his barrel into the ground, while bubbles pop out of the top of the barrel. These bubbles move towards the player, and explode once they get close enough.

attacks.name: Oncoming Storm
attacks.text: Aquarius slams his barrel into the ground, and begins launching concentrated storm orbs out of the top. These scatter and land around the player randomly, erupting into a column of wind and lightning where they land.

attacks.name: Separation Anxiety (Grapple)
attacks.text: Aquarius teleports to one side of the arena, and throws his barrel across the arena. It bounces off the other side, then slows to rest in the middle. While it is away from Aquarius, it attempts to pull in any nearby player by sucking in wind. If a player gets caught in it they get stuck in the barrel, and Aquarius delivers a devastating body slam that throws the player into the opposing wall.

attacks.name: Autophobia
attacks.text: Aquarius teleports to the far side of the arena, and begins pushing the player away with wind from his barrel. At the same time, storm columns launch out of the barrel as well, forcing the player to move towards Aquarius and jump/dodge through the openings in the columns.

attacks.name: Wind Between the Waves
attacks.text: Aquarius will jump up into the sky, leaving his barrel to hover above the center of the arena. The barrel proceeds to shoot out 3 waves of solar orbs with gaps in them, forcing the player to move to the gaps to avoid damage. At the end, Aquarius falls back down on the player, damaging those who don't dash out of the way fast enough. It should be noted that Aquarius will only use this attack when at or below 50% health.

attacks.name: Panic Attack (Ultimate)
attacks.text: Once Aquarius' Astral Gauge is full, he slithers into his barrel, and floats to the center of the arena. A gigantic attack indicator then forms around the barrel, completely covering the arena. If left alone, this attack will often instantly kill a player, for after a certain amount of time Aquarius will release the pent-up energy in a massive spread of powerful explosions that ranges throughout the entire indicator. However, the size of the indicator can be reduced by attacking the barrel that Aquarius is hiding in.

attacks.name: exec_func: "boot_sequence"
attacks.text: Libra will throw her haladie towards the player, and after a certain distance it will slow down and return to Libra like a boomerang. After it returns, libra will teleport above the player and attempt to slam on them, creating a laser column.

attacks.name: exec_func: "terror_bite"
attacks.text: Libra dash towards the player, while slashing along the path with her haladie. After the dash, lighting strike along the path from above.

attacks.name: exec_func: "orbital_strike"
attacks.text: Libra summons a large orbital strike aimed at the player, forcing them to dash away or take damage.

attacks.name: exec_func: "upload/download"
attacks.text: Libra uploads lightning orbs into the clouds, then proceeds to download pain directly into the player's body via a slashing dive. After the dive, the uploaded lightning orbs download lightning strikes into the ground behind the attack.

attacks.name: exec_func: "overclock"
attacks.text: Libra overclocks her systems, releasing a plethora of lasers while spinning her haladie around. For the first three iterations of this attack, the spew of lasers is aimed at the player and leaves a safe zone on the opposite side of Libra. After three large bursts, Libra then shifts the attack into a swirling pattern, firing lasers in either a clockwise or counterclockwise orbit around her, forcing the player to be constantly moving around her to not get hit. It should be noted that Libra has an invincible shield during this attack, and cannot be attacked.

attacks.name: exec_func: "data_transfer"
attacks.text: Libra summons an orb of light filled with data, with which she attempts to transfer into the player's body. However, since it isn't formatted as a hard drive, it ends up damaging them instead. The data is manifested as lightning orbs similar to Virgo's, which will aim at the player and damage them both when they arrive and while they are flying.

attacks.name: exec_func: "delete" (Ultimate)
attacks.text: When Libra's Astral Gauge is fully charged, she will begin hovering above the center of the arena, charging her ultimate attack. When charged, she releases a gigantic laser column at the center of the arena, trapping the player on one of the two edges. The laser persists for a little bit, while smaller lasers bombard both sides of the arena. When finished, she will fly out of sight, and prepare a laser strike which could be on either side of the arena. Two red indicators form, each covering half of the arena. Once Libra decides which side to strike, that side's indicator will start flashing and expand while the other disappears. In a moment, Libra will slam down and create another gigantic laser column, from which the player must dash away from to avoid.

attacks.name: Glimpse of the Other Side
attacks.text: Gemini teleports to the far side of the arena, then throws their scythe down onto the player, creating a damaging column of lightning where it lands. They then start channeling a wind gust to pull the player toward them, shortly pulling their scythe toward them as well. It spins and damages the player along the way, until they catch it. Gemini will often initiate the fight with this attack.

attacks.name: Twin Peaks
attacks.text: Gemini will slash horizontally with their scythe, then send out a clone to slash in a vertical circle around the player. To dodge, the player needs to dash out of the way at the right time.

attacks.name: Refraction
attacks.text: Gemini disappears from the arena, and summons 6 additional clones to attack from the sky. Of the seven clones above, only 6 will crash down in a pillar of lightning. The fake clone is indicated by a blue indicator instead of a red one. Gemini's clones will attack three times, randomizing the placement of the feinting clone each time.

attacks.name: Lesson Learned
attacks.text: Gemini Dashes at the player, slashing with their scythe and summoning a vertical column of lightning. Shortly after, a secondary, horizontal lightning beam is shot at the player.

attacks.name: La Danse Macabre
attacks.text: Gemini summons clones, across the arena from them, then throws their scythe between each other, damaging any players in the way. They pass the scythe around three times before stopping.

attacks.name: Memento Mori
attacks.text: Gemini summons a phantom clone in a random place in the arena, which is trapped in time and grows a blue, circular indicator around it. This clone will remain frozen until a player comes within its indicator range. Once that happens, the circle will quickly expand horizontally to become an oval, turning red in the process. Once fully expanded, the clone will break out of their stasis, and swing their scythe in a large area, reaching the entire oval.

attacks.name: Death's Door (Ultimate)
attacks.text: This attack will only be used once Gemini's Astral Gauge is full, when their patience grows thin. Gemini will create 8 additional clones, and form a circle around the center of the arena. They use powerful wind gusts to keep the player inside the circle, and throw a singular scythe down at the player. Each time the scythe hits the ground, a random clone other than the one that threw it will draw it to them, then repeat the cycle. They repeat this 6 times, repeatedly throwing and retrieving the scythe. It should be noted that the scythe damages any player as long as it is moving. After passing the scythe around, all the clones disappear, and two horizontal lightning beams fire off, one on the ground, one in the air. It is completely random which one fires first.

attacks.name: World Splitter
attacks.text: Ophiuchus will teleport above the player, then perform a massive slash with his dual swords.

attacks.name: Swift Execution
attacks.text: Ophiuchus will teleport to one side of the arena, and prepare a slash attack across the floor. As he does, attack indicators will be revealed in a somewhat random pattern around the arena, which show which areas will be covered in astral energies when he finishes the attack. The player will need to quickly move to one of the few safe areas to avoid getting hit.

attacks.name: Falling Stars
attacks.text: Ophiuchus will jump into the air, and teleport to one side of the arena, where he will slam both of his swords to the ground. A diagonal line of swords will form and begin to fall, originating from behind Ophiuchus when he started the attack.

attacks.name: Somber Swords
attacks.text: Ophiuchus will hover in the middle of the arena, casting his swords down upon the player. He will summon a total of 7 swords, one at a time, which will slam down onto the player, and continue to damage any player that touches them. The damaging swords will persist until the attack is done.

attacks.name: Slithering Strikes
attacks.text: Ophiuchus will teleport out of sight, then quickly teleport near the player and perform a quick sword strike from a random direction. The amount of times he does this increases with how low his health currently is, starting at 2 strikes when his health is full, eventually reaching up to 4 times when his health is almost depleted.

attacks.name: Mirrored Misery
attacks.text: Ophiuchus does not directly attack the player, but instead summons a Shadow Clone of the character the player is currently playing. It should be noted that Ophiuchus is no longer in the arena during this attack, and cannot do other attacks or by damaged. Ophiuchus will only use this attack when he reaches 50% health, and will not use it again during his fight.

attacks.name: Constricting Fangs
attacks.text: Ophiuchus will throw his swords around the arena, then teleport away. He will then teleport to one of the four swords that float in the air, perform a dash attack with the sword, then teleport to another sword and do another attack. This continues until there are no more swords left in the air.

attacks.name: Astral Projection
attacks.text: Ophiuchus will teleport out of the arena, and summon a phantom of one of the 12 Zodiacs to perform a random attack from their own set of attacks. Neither Ophiuchus or the summoned Zodiac can be attacked during this move, and the zodiac will disappear after their attack has concluded.

attacks.name: Stellar Ruin (Ultimate)
attacks.text: When the Astral Gauge is full, Ophiuchus will teleport into the background of the arena, and begin charging up the attack. Once fully charged, the orb he holds will begin releasing meteor-like projectiles that will explode in random places around the arena. After a few seconds, Ophiuchus will cast the large orb and 6 smaller orbs towards the player, creating a large explosion where it lands, as well as more explosions in an upside-down T-shape from the smaller projectiles.

attacks.name: Wave of Destruction (World Splitter)
attacks.text: The initial overhead slash is now thinner, and generally easier to dodge. However, where it hits the ground it sends two waves in either direction across the arena floor.

attacks.name: Arranged Anguish (Swift Execution)
attacks.text: The patterns that can be used are the same, however each individual slash in the pattern no longer lingers until the attack activates. They now disappear immediately after flashing, forcing the player to memorize the safe spots as they become apparent.

attacks.name: Despondent Dive (Falling Stars)
attacks.text: After the first row of swords hits the ground, Ophiuchus will perform a second dive on the opposite side of the arena. The second dive is identical to the first, summoning a mirrored row of swords.

attacks.name: Triple Slice
attacks.text: Lupus swings his sabres in front of him three times in succession, always facing towards the player while doing so. The height this covers is about as tall as him and extends a fair distance away from him. Upon entering the fight, Lupus will always use this attack first.

attacks.name: Dash Attack
attacks.text: Lupus disappears off stage, only to then dash across the entire bottom of the arena, damaging any player who didn't jump above the area of affect or dodge through it. The height of the attack is about as tall as Lupus.

attacks.name: Spin Slam
attacks.text: The specter jumps up and starts spinning into a ball, at which point he will attempt to catch the player in an area of affect that extends vertically the length of the arena and is about as wide as the circle he spins himself into. After Lupus decides on which area to attack (given by the fact the column of effect will stop moving), he will wait about half a second before slamming himself into the ground, in which the player has time to dash out of the way.

attacks.name: Ultimate: Missile Storm
attacks.text: This attack starts very similarly to the Spin Slam attack, where Lupus will jump up into the air and start spinning in a circle. This circle will damage the player if they get hit by it, and will create a pulling force to attempt to draw the player in. During this, Lupus will release missiles that aim at the player's current position, and will create a small area of damage when they explode. After a certain amount of missiles are released, Lupus will finish his attack the same way as Spin Slam, by aiming at the player and slamming down into the ground.

attacks.name: Electric Dissonance - Fan Color: Yellow
attacks.text: Pegasus will raise one of their fans above their head, summoning three electric orbs. They will then launch the orbs towards the player's current position, which will explode when they hit the ground, shooting a column of damaging light upwards. Upon entering the fight, Pegasus will always use this attack first.

attacks.name: Slicing Maelstrom - Fan Color: White-Blue
attacks.text: Pegasus will spin in a circle before raising both fans in front of their face. They will then dash towards the player and release a gust of wind that swirls around them, damaging the player if they are too close.

attacks.name: Bubble Geyser - Fan Color: Dark Blue
attacks.text: Pegasus will teleport to one side of the arena at random, raise both fans above their head, then push them towards the player. This summons two lines of bubbles that cover the top and bottom of the arena. The bubbles will explode in pairs, in timed order leading away from where Pegasus cast the spell, damaging anything that is in between each pair.

attacks.name: Ultimate: Thunderstorm - Fan Color: Yellow
attacks.text: This attack acts as an enhanced version of Electric Dissonance, and will have to be dodged similarly. Pegasus will raise one of their fans above their head, summoning five electric orbs instead of three. These orbs will be launched towards the player's current position, each landing an equal distance away from one another. Pegasus will then teleport to the opposite end of the arena, and repeat the same motions; summoning electric orbs and launching them at the player. It should be noted that Pegasus is completely invincible during this attack.

attacks.name: Blazing Wheel
attacks.text: Draco will jump into the air and transform into a spinning wheel of fire. A red path will extend from the wheel and mark the areas that the wheel will go. Shortly after, the wheel will be released and very quickly speed along the path, so it is best to get out of the way as soon as possible. Upon entering the fight, Draco will always use this attack first.

attacks.name: Meteor Strikes
attacks.text: Draco will teleport and hover in the air, and light his hands on fire. He will then punch the air in front of him, and for each punch an explosive meteor will crash into the field.

attacks.name: Flaming Tornado
attacks.text: Draco will perform an uppercut while leaping into the air, sending a fiery tornado in the player's direction. Then, he will launch himself from the air towards the player, exploding on impact.

attacks.name: Ultimate: Dragon's Judgement
attacks.text: This attack functions as an enhanced version of Meteor Strikes, and will start the same way. Draco will leap up into the air, and perform a lightning-fast series of punches, sending down a shower of explosive meteors. He will summon forty-two meteors in total, in groups of six at a time. Draco can only use this ability once his Starlight Gauge is full, and he is not currently performing another attack. It should be noted that Draco is completely invincible during this attack, so it is best to avoid the meteors until the attack is over.

attacks.name: Glorious Blaze
attacks.text: Draco will teleport behind the player, and explode in a large ball of fire. At the same time, two tornados filled with fire will sweep across the arena. They reach all the way up to the top of the arena, so the player must dash through them to avoid damage. The best way to dodge this attack is to dash away from Hydra as soon as he teleports, then dash towards him again, avoiding damage from the tornados.

attacks.name: Thundering Strike
attacks.text: Hydra will slam their staff down onto the ground, summoning two lightning strikes. The first comes from above, and will aim at the player before striking. The second sweeps the floor of the arena, damaging everything up to about the height of Hydra. The best way for the player to dodge this attack is to dash when the first bolt is about to strike, then jump over the second bolt, since the dash will most likely still be on cooldown.

attacks.name: Hailstorm
attacks.text: Hydra will summon a ball of ice that hovers above the player's head, as he prepares to swing his staff. Five red lines will extend from the orb, marking out where the orb will fire projectiles. They appear in sequential order, starting from either the left or the right. Once Hydra swings his staff, the orb will stop following the player and start firing ice shards, following the same order that the lines appeared in. In order to avoid taking damage, the player must dash out of the attack as soon as the orb stops moving(when Hydra swings his staff).

attacks.name: Ultimate: Lightning Barrage
attacks.text: Hydra will teleport to the center of the arena, hover above the ground, and raise his staff into the air. He will summon six lightning strikes down onto the arena, each directly aimed at the player. Every time a lightning bolt strikes, it will leave a column of lightning that will remain in that spot until the attack is finished. These columns can damage the player if they run into them, but can also be dashed through, like every other attack. The best way to deal with this attack is to start from one end of the arena, and run to the other side, drawing out each strike and dashing through lightning columns as little as possible.

attacks.name: Cold Gust
attacks.text: Monoceros will dash towards the player quickly, then thrust his lance forward. At the same time, he will release a large gust of swirling wind, damaging the player if they are inside the area of effect. This attack will cover about half of the arena, and is generally too tall to jump over if the player is not already in the air. The best way to dodge this attack is to dodge out of the area as soon as possible. Upon entering the fight, Monoceros will always use this attack first.

attacks.name: Glacier Breaker
attacks.text: Monoceros will plunge his lance into the ground, growing a large glacier in front of him. The glacier will explode once he pulls his lance out of the ground, launching four ice shards up into the air.These shards can bounce off of walls, but will break and deal damage once they hit the ground. This means that this attack gets three different chances to damage the player: When he summons the ice it deals area damage, when he breaks the ice it will damage the same area, and the ice shards that are left will damage the player on contact. The best way to dodge this attack is to dodge to either side to avoid the area of effect, then dodge back towards the center once it breaks to avoid the ice shards.

attacks.name: Icicle Mines
attacks.text: Monoceros will summon three floating mines spread across the battlefield, which will slowly move towards the player and explode after a few seconds. The mines do not damage the player while they are seeking, only when they explode. Once again, the best way to dodge this attack is to dash out of the area right as the mines are about to explode. Jumping over them will be useless, since they can travel upward and still hit the player.

attacks.name: Ultimate: Arctic Wind
attacks.text: This attack is similar to his Cold Gust attack, and acts as an enhanced version. Monoceros will teleport to either the far right or far right side of the arena, and thrust his lance forward. This sends a huge gust of icy wind across the arena, which will damage the player if it sweeps across them. It does not travel instantly, and instead acts as a sweeping wave attack. The attack is too high to jump over unless you have the Agile Foot aura upgrade, which will give the player an additional jump. Because of this, the best way to dodge this attack is to dash through the wave as it moves towards you.

attacks.name: Shape
attacks.text: The Sculptor will teleport behind the player and bring his hammer crashing down upon them, then repeat the attack on the other side of the player. Each time the hammer hits, it will cause a large area of effect, that will damage any player inside it. The best way to dodge this attack is to dash out of the area once the red attack projection appears.

attacks.name: Cut
attacks.text: The Sculptor will teleport his scythe to the far end of the side he dashed to. The scythe will horizontally spin, and quickly accelerate across the entire floor of the arena. Once it reaches the other side, it will rotate and start spinning vertically, covering about double the height of the initial sweep. It will then accelerate in the opposite direction, sweeping the arena once again. The best way to dodge this attack is to jump once to avoid the first sweep, then jump a second time to jump over the second sweep, since it is taller than the first. Depending on where the player is, a dash may be needed to stay above the second sweep.

attacks.name: Chip
attacks.text: The Sculptor will teleport his bow to the top of the arena, where it will then fire three shots down upon the player, teleporting to a different location each time. The bow will target the player directly, and does not predict the player's movement. Because of this, the player can generally run in a straight line to avoid getting hit. However, a dash may be needed to avoid damage if the player runs to the side of the arena, or if the firing angle is too shallow.

attacks.name: Ultimate: Finishing Touch
attacks.text: This attack will begin the same way as Chip, with the Sculptor teleporting his bow to the top of the arena. The bow will instead turn gold, and fire at the player eight times, teleporting to a new location after each arrow is released. Similar to Chip, this attack can be dodged by simply running in a straight line, since the arrows are not predictive. This attack can only be used once the Sculptor's Starlight Gauge is filled, which charges up over time. It should be noted that the Sculptor is completely invincible for the duration of this attack, so it is best to focus on dodging.

effects.desc: Fire explosion. Size and damage are proportional to the amount of stacks.

effects.name: Freeze
effects.desc: Slows down enemies by 5% per stack (except bosses) and applies Frostbite when reaching 10 stacks.

effects.name: Frostbite
effects.desc: Prevents enemies from moving and attacking for 3 sections (except for bosses) and deals damage over time.

effects.name: Poison
effects.desc: Deals damage over time that is increased for each stack.

effects.name: Electrify
effects.desc: 10% chance per stack to create Spark on Basic Attack hits.

effects.desc: Bounces off enemies 4 times causing damage. Cannot target the same enemy 2 times in a row. Will target the nearest enemy if it reaches max distance without bouncing.

effects.name: Neutral
effects.desc: No additional effects added unless specified.

effects.desc: Sets enemies on fire for 5 seconds, dealing fire damage over time. On each hit, 75% chance to apply 1 Burn. (One Ignition per enemy)

effects.name: Ember
effects.desc: Flames that set the ground on fire for 2.5 seconds. On each hit, 25% chance to apply 1 Burn.

effects.name: Wisps
effects.desc: Follows you and shoots 4 projectiles at enemies before disappearing. On each hit, 50% chance to apply 1 Burn.

effects.name: Fire Shield
effects.desc: Fire circle that deals damage to enemies on contact. On each hit, 75% chance to apply 1 Burn. (1 Fire Shield per player)

effects.name: Ice Idols
effects.desc: Pulls enemies and creates ice spikes for 3 seconds. One each hit, 50% chance to apply 1 Freeze.

effects.name: Snowflake
effects.desc: A projectile that orbits around you. On hit, causes damage and has a 25% chance to apply 1 Freeze.

effects.name: Ice Fragment
effects.desc: Projectile that pierces enemies and bounces off wall and ground. On each hit, 25% chance to apply 1 Freeze.

effects.name: Ice Sword
effects.desc: Targets and falls on one enemy. On hit, 50% chance to apply 1 Freeze.

effects.name: Slimes
effects.desc: Bounces toward nearby enemies and explodes. On hit, 25% chance to apply 1 Poison.

effects.name: Sapling
effects.desc: Follows you and explodes on nearby enemies. On hit, 25% chance to apply 1 Poison.

effects.name: Toxic Gas
effects.desc: Poison explosion dealing damage to enemies around. On hit, 75% chance to apply 1 Poison.

effects.name: Meteor
effects.desc: Falls on one random enemy. On each hit, 50% chance to apply 1 poison.

effects.name: Plasma
effects.desc: Invokes an energy beam on one enemy. On hit, 25% chance to apply 1 Electrify.

effects.name: Nimbus
effects.desc: Follows you and casts 3 thunders on enemies. On each hit, 50% chance to apply 1 Electrify.

effects.name: Lightning Orb
effects.desc: Strikes enemies at range for 4 seconds. On each hit, 25% to apply 1 Electrify.

effects.name: Thunder Strike
effects.desc: Strikes one random enemy. On hit, 50% chance to apply 1 Electrify.

effects.name: Vulnerability
effects.desc: Increases damage received by enemy by 5% per stack.

effects.name: Pacification
effects.desc: Reduces damage dealt by enemy by 5% per stack.

effects.name: Target
effects.desc: Next hit becomes a Critical Hit.

effects.name: Missiles
effects.desc: Follow you and shot at one nearby enemy.

effects.name: Yalee
effects.desc: Casts 3 projectiles with cuteness to one nearby enemy. On each hit, 25% chance to apply 1 Random Effect.

effects.name: Spirit Sword
effects.desc: Follows you and attacks nearby enemy 3 times.

destiny.name: The Hidden Face of the Garden
destiny.text: This modifier changes how all non-boss enemies behave. The room combat will become more difficult, however; Zodiac encounters are unchanged outside of the general life and damage increase.

destiny.name: Star Stream Flow
destiny.text: This modifier increases the minimum difficulty of every room, meaning that you'll encounter more enemy spawns and more difficult enemies. The increase in difficulty provides more Star-Fragments, resulting in a net positive for the player who can overcome the difficulty increase.

destiny.name: Shadow Clones
destiny.text: This modifier adds the shadow clones from the Ophiuchus fight to the random spawns in each Exploration room. Defeating these clones yields Star Fragments, experience as well as a random higher rarity Gambit, meaning that this modifier provides additional rewards to the player.

destiny.name: Dark Unity
destiny.text: This modifier adds a significant increase in the life and damage of all enemies, including Zodiacs. This Destiny Level is generally considered the first major difficulty spike after completing the game for the first time. The player must improve their ability to dodge and develop stronger builds to handle the new challenge.

destiny.name: Imperial Decree
destiny.text: This modifier doubles the number of Elite enemies that spawn. These enemies provide significantly more challenge than standard enemies and reward the player with a number of Star Fragments, making this modifier valuable to the player.

destiny.name: Final Confrontation
destiny.text: This modifier unlocks the true potential of all of the Zodiacs, including Ophiuchus. All Zodiacs will have new attack patterns and provide a significantly larger challenge. The Ophiuchus fight in particular sees more major changes. This modifier unlocks endings for all player characters and Zodiac's teaming up with the player. This is considered the most difficult challenge up to this point and will test the player's knowledge and skills in new ways. For tips and strategies see here. The player's Destiny Fragment Allocation will be much more critical at this stage of the game.
